findings.issue: Header says only import and namespace changed, but diff also shows two mul_le_mul_right -> mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ substitutions, two removed terminal ring tactics, and explicit theorem application adjustment. These are proof/API compatibility changes, not mathematical changes.

mathematical_checks: Anti-concentration proof uses exact hypergeometric moments, reversible birth/death recurrence, a positive maximizing atom and variance split at 16. Positive variance correctly excludes populations 0/1 and degenerate hypergeometric laws. Constant 4 preserved.

FiniteLaw to PMF adapters equate actual finite weighted expectations/probabilities; no probability input is assumed. transformBound holds for all positive s, so lower tail as well as upper tail supported.

Cylinder uses full n-population uniform column assignments. Equal-fibre relabeling proves the union of arbitrary allowed digits is a uniform fixed-size subset. A deterministic marked row-set R is then intersected across independent full-population columns. There is no false independence of row indicators.

Cylinder recursion handles d=0 via empty product=1 and retained R; n=0 makes R empty, transform exactly 1 and mean zero, so totalized ratios do not create a false event. Empty/complete digit sets and zero piles have correct subset laws.
Tail constant remains denominator 4*(mu+t), matching assigned U02 input; the later manuscript denominator-2 exploration display is not claimed.

anchorCylinderTransform is unconditional for a deterministic R and deterministic digit sets; applying to a random exposed anchor requires a separately proved future-column conditional independence/disintegration adapter. The file does not itself claim that adapter.
